protocol.selection: pooled inner MSE over two feature views; fixed other parameters
protocol.budget_limit: equal candidates, folds, seeds and tree count; not equal compute, capacity or optimization effort
protocol.categorical_policy: same one-hot representation; CatBoost native categorical treatment not evaluated
protocol.modern_foundation_models: not evaluated; no claim of state-of-the-art

timing_note: shared preprocessing logged separately; wall times are local observations and can reflect concurrent load
